INSERT INTO call_records (
                    id,
                    channel_id,
                    room_name,
                    created_by,
                    started_at,
                    ended_at,
                    duration_ms,
                    share_permission_id
                )
                VALUES (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    'call-access-test',
                    $3,
                    NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour',
                    NOW(),
                    3600000,
                    $4
                )
